original_requirement: From the authorized clean 11aa5e9 baseline, reuse only trustworthy historical Provider/model evidence to populate the Route Capability Registry, require VERIFIED only for Exact READY routes, keep insufficient routes UNKNOWN_BLOCKED, close CAPACITY_PHYSICAL_ATTEMPT_DRIFT where evidence permits, and make no credential, network, model, paid, or real Full Short call.
closed_world_justification: The changed behavior is limited to deterministic materialization of a finite, hash-bound set of repository evidence and the user-supplied 15-entry screenshot package into the existing 14-record route registry. No parser for arbitrary Provider responses or model output changed.
operational_definition: A route is promoted only when both numeric capacity fields and the exact operator, destination, protocol, model, and route fingerprint are source-grounded. Partial screenshots remain evidence locators on UNKNOWN_BLOCKED records. Exact READY planning stops before dispatch while any required primary record is unknown, and every external-action counter remains zero.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not infer relay capacity from an upstream or same-named model.
Do not turn request caps, policy ceilings, observed outputs, badges, or parameter presence into Provider maxima.
Do not require unused fallback routes to be VERIFIED for the current Exact READY plan.
Do not reuse historical authorization, approval, nonce, run ID, store, credential, or secret.
Do not report V3 closed while required Exact READY routes remain UNKNOWN_BLOCKED.
